title: get_position_in_chat casts i64 COUNT to u32, silently truncating at 4 billion messages
description: MessageStore::get_position_in_chat() returns Ok(pos.map(|p| p as u32)) where p is an i64 from SQL COUNT(*). At > 2^32 messages the cast silently truncates. The return type should be u64 (or usize) to match count_by_chat() which returns usize. The public signature change propagates to callers. Example fix: change return type to Result<Option<u64>, KithError> and cast as u64 instead of u32.
